responsibility: This header defines the public data structures and declarations for BPF CO-RE and .BTF.ext emission used by the BPF backend. It describes the on-disk BTF.ext header, section, funcinfo, lineinfo, and relocation record layouts, enumerates the supported CO-RE relocation kinds, and declares the initialization/output helpers plus relocation-construction routines implemented in coreout.cc that are called from the main backend when generating BTF-based relocation metadata.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-stem coreout file, this header provides the shared interface and on-disk structure definitions for .BTF.ext and CO-RE relocation support, including enums and function prototypes. The sibling coreout.cc contains the actual logic that constructs relocation entries, manages section data, and outputs the .BTF.ext section.
